name: NimBLE-IDF
description: NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.1's C++ API (h2zero, Apache-2.0) on the framework's own NimBLE host (ESP-IDF's bt component): for the ESP32-P4, whose Bluetooth is an ESP32-C6's over ESP-Hosted (the framework's NimBLE talks to it), which NimBLE-Arduino's own bundled host and controller port can't do
